question: In February 2025, which athlete broke her own women’s 400 m National Games record, clocking 51.12 seconds to win gold?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Aishwarya Mishra**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In **February 2025**, during the **38th National Games**, athlete **Aishwarya Mishra** clinched the **gold medal** in the **women’s 400 m** event.
 
• She clocked an impressive timing of **51.12 seconds**, which set a new benchmark in the history of the **National Games** for this category.
 
• By achieving this feat, she successfully broke her own previous **National Games record** of **51.18 seconds**, which she had established during the **36th National Games** held in **Gujarat** in **2022**.
 
• **Aishwarya Mishra** represents the state of **Maharashtra** in domestic competitions and has been a consistent performer in the **quarter-mile** sprint at the national level.
 
• This performance in **Uttarakhand** further solidifies her position as one of India's leading **400 m** runners, approaching the **Asian Games** and international qualification standards.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **38th National Games 2025**:
 
 
• The **2025** edition of the **National Games** is hosted by the state of **Uttarakhand**.
 
• Events are spread across major cities including **Dehradun**, **Haldwani**, **Rishikesh**, and **Haridwar**.
 
• The games serve as a prestigious platform for Indian athletes to showcase their talent across **38 different sports** disciplines.
 
 
 
• **Hima Das**:
 
 
• Known as the **“Dhing Express”**, she is a specialist **400 m** and **200 m** runner from **Assam**.
 
• She holds the current **Indian National Record** in **400 m** with a time of **50.79 seconds**, set during the **2018 Asian Games** in **Jakarta**.
 
 
 
• **Jyothi Yarraji**:
 
 
• She is India’s premier **100 m hurdler** and holds the **national record** in the **100 m hurdles** event.
 
• She became the first Indian woman to run the **100 m hurdles** in under **13 seconds**.
 
 
 
• **Dutee Chand**:
 
 
• A prominent sprinter from **Odisha**, she specializes in the **100 m** and **200 m** events.
 
• She is a **two-time silver medalist** at the **Asian Games** and held the national record for the **100 m** dash for several years.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• The **National Games** are organized by the **Indian Olympic Association (IOA)** to identify and nurture sporting talent for international events like the **Olympics** and **Commonwealth Games**.
 
• The **women’s 400 m** event is a critical component of the **4x400 m relay team**, which has traditionally been a strong event for **India** at the **Asian** level.
 
• Timing below **52 seconds** is considered world-class in the domestic circuit and helps athletes secure spots in the **National Camp** managed by the **Athletics Federation of India (AFI)**.
 
• **Aishwarya Mishra** has previously won medals at the **Asian Athletics Championships**, making her a key figure in India’s **middle-distance** sprinting strategy.
